tools.name: check_spreadsheet
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to check a spreadsheet for errors or validate data before importing or sending it: "check spreadsheet for errors", "data validation excel", "find duplicates in excel", "check this csv for errors", "find invalid dates", "are there bad emails in this list". Attach a CSV, T

tools.name: list_spreadsheet_columns
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to see what is in a spreadsheet before validating it, or asks which columns, types or values it has: "what columns are in this file", "profile this csv", "which column is the ID", "suggest validation rules". Attach a CSV, TSV or .xlsx file or paste the table. Returns eac

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_spreadsheet, list_spreadsheet_columns · Private data: check_spreadsheet, list_spreadsheet_columns · Public sink: check_spreadsheet, list_spreadsheet_columns · Destructive: check_spreadsheet.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_spreadsheet, list_spreadsheet_columns · Private data: check_spreadsheet, list_spreadsheet_columns · Public sink: check_spreadsheet, list_spreadsheet_columns · Destructive: check_spreadsheet

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
